items.name: Vortex

Create ONE finished abstract emblem, front-facing orthographic, centered in a square canvas, emblem occupying about 72% of the canvas with generous clear margin. Truly transparent background.
Visual language: elegant ancient-future civic heraldry; bold sculptural geometry; warm pale platinum face, narrowly bevelled metal edges, dark recessed cuts, very restrained luminous colored enamel inside a few major channels. Sophisticated and mysterious, austere, memorable. Clear masses and intentional negative space. Strong silhouette readable at 48 pixels. Keep to 3-7 main visual parts and broad thick strokes; no thin filigree. A flat graphic silhouette with subtle material depth, not a scene.
Every cutout outside/between the mark should be actual transparent negative space. No enclosing coin, outer medallion, common shield template, vignette, background plane, drop shadow, nebula, stars, smoke, lettering, numbers, labels, runes, watermark, extra ornaments, or presentation mockup. No color reliance for identity. Do not draw the affinity icons separately. The geometry must form one integrated distinctive mark.

Name for internal reference only (DO NOT print): Testament.
Affinities: Radiance + Continuum + Abyss.
Geometry and meaning: A tall open arch whose apex keystone is conspicuously missing, leaving a square negative-space absence at the very top. Beneath the empty apex a broad suspended horizontal governing bar joins two inner vertical uprights, which descend and remain tied by a heavy lower bracket. The vanished source's imprint is echoed once in a square notch on the governing bar. Compact upright monumental seal, visibly incomplete at the top but firmly bound below. No book, scroll, writing, tombstone, cross or ghost. Violet #7B1FA2 in the absent-apex facing cuts, pale gold #DFC878 along the surviving directive bar, cobalt #3D6BFF along its continuing lower binding structure.
